newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria to close embassy in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria to close embassy in Canada.

text.p: Nigeria's military government on Friday said it had decided to close its embassy in Canada, which has been very critical of Nigeria's human rights record.
"The Nigerian economy can no longer sustain the maintenance of a large number of diplomatic missions and personnel abroad," a statement from the foreign ministry said.
"This closure of our mission is without prejudice to existing relations, agreements or on-going programmes between Nigeria and Canada."
Canada has been pushing for the Commonwealth of Britain and its former colonies to take tough action against Nigeria for alleged human rights abuses and lack of democracy.
Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation, was suspended from the Commonwealth in November after the hanging of nine minority rights activists for murder despite international appeals for clemency.
In June, when other Commonwealth countries put off possible sanctions to give Nigeria a chance for dialogue, Canada said it would impose its own limited sanctions.
A new diplomatic row erupted last month, when Nigeria said a team of Commonwealth ministers planning a visit to discuss Nigeria's suspension would only allowed to speak to government officials.
"Due consideration must be given to opening a diplomatic mission in Canada in future should circumstances improve," the statement said.
